answer_1.quote: We propose a novel framework for paper taxonomy generation that leverages LLM-guided, multi-aspect representations in conjunction with adaptive clustering.

answer_2.quote: To assess papers categorization, we report three widely used clustering metrics: Normalized Mutual Information (NMI), Adjusted Rand Index (ARI), and Purity. For topic quality and structural alignment, we adopt Heading Soft Recall (HSR) and Catalogue Edit Distance Similarity (CEDS).

answer_3.quote: The evaluation is performed by six reviewers: three PhD students in computer science and three advanced LLMs: GPT-4o (2024-11-20), Claude 3.7 Sonnet (2025-02-19), and LLaMA-3.3-70B Instruct.
methods: human evaluation with LLMs as annotators

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation on five dimensions: Coverage, Relevance, Structure, Validity, and Adequacy.
